item.title: Watashi-tachi Marriage 1
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kuro Irodoru Yomiji
  • 発売日: 2022-09-23
  • スコア: 6.42/10 (52 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 私たちマリアージュ①
  • 英語名: Watashi-tachi Marriage 1

别名

  • Watamari – A Match Made in Heaven

あらすじ

Spring.

Hoshino Hikari is a new transfer student to the prestigious St. Leanne Girl’s Academy. But she’s no ordinary student, as she’s been sent there as an agent by the “Agency”, who are interested in the secrets hidden within the school. While her transferring in is quite extraordinary, everyone is more interested in the ritual that takes place before the opening ceremonies.

item.description:

  • スコア: 7.01/10 (324 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ねのかみ 京の都とふたりの姫騎士
  • 英語名: Ne no Kami - Kyou no Miyako to Futari no Hime Kishi

别名

  • Ne no Kami - Kyou no Miyako to Futari no Hime Kishi

あらすじ

~At dawn, the moonlight illuminates the old capital enveloped in fog. Guided by fate, bound by their thoughts, the maidens dance. Amid a spiral of despair, the beloved princess and her guardian knight overcome their fear. Gazing up at the dawn sky, the princess of the earth gently averts her eyes. Descended from the heavens, bearing her dreams. Scooping up the ripples from the water’s surface. The princess of the sun gazes, and contemplates. Light dwelling in their cerulean eyes, and with a will that can break down the wall of fate.

item.description:

  • スコア: 5.8100000000000005/10 (153 人評価)
  • 日本語名: サクラメントの十二宮 乱れる仔ひつじと手懐く狼
  • 英語名: Sacrament no Juunikyuu: Midareru Kohitsuji to Tenazuku Ookami

别名

  • Sacrament no Juunikyuu‛： Midareru Kohitsuji to Tenazuku Ookami

あらすじ

Every year, there is a ritual called the “Sacrament”, where they pray and get baptized to the goddess. There is a school saying, that if during this time a person shows one of the twelve zodiac stigmas, they will bring happiness to all. Alissa, who has been chosen as the Princess of the White Sheep, falls in love at first sight with Hitsuji, a recent transfer student. Understanding Hitsuji’s intentions, Alissa is attracted by her strength and awkwardness and decides to accept her.
